summary: Wrote a nine-phase sequential plan (12.5 hours) for the connective signature layer, following the research report's option (i): a layer-0 signature module, generated per-language bodies, clause classes as Prop mixins, one home for the interval operators and next/prev, and signature-driven recognition. Phase 1 is a landing gate that blocks until the temporal contribution (PR 8, still open) is on main. Carried figures were re-checked: 17 doubled operators, TemporalIntervals.lean already on main, clause-class names in 19 files, GenericSchemata.lean at 1440 lines. One issue was recorded to the issue log.
